summary: Iteration 10 — BYO Try-On + multi-address delivery book. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passing (BYO validation/role gating, full address CRUD including default-promotion semantics & cross-tenant isolation, checkout requires address_id with shipping_address snapshot on the order). Frontend: AddressPickerSheet enforces selection with inline-add when none exist; all spec testIDs render on the BYO screen and addresses form; checkout POST captured with address_id in body. ONE CRITICAL FE↔BE BUG: BYO garment_type values in the Try-On UI ('top', 'bottom', 'accessory') are not in the backend GarmentType Literal — picking those chips yields 422 from /api/tryon/garment.

ui_bugs.issue: FE chips 'top', 'bottom', 'accessory' (testIDs byo-type-top/bottom/accessory) send values that fail backend Pydantic validation. Backend GarmentType only allows: vest_under, shirt, dress, skirt, trousers, shorts, belt, tie, scarf, waistcoat, outerwear, socks, shoes, hat, bag, jewelry, other. Selecting Top/Bottom/Accessory + tapping 'Try It On' returns HTTP 422. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tryon/byo.tsx:27-34 and /app/backend/models.py:57-75.

action_items: Fix BYO garment_type mismatch: either (a) map FE keys to canonical backend values inside /app/frontend/app/tryon/byo.tsx generate() (e.g. top→shirt, bottom→trousers, accessory→other) before calling api.tryOnGarment, OR (b) extend backend GarmentType Literal in /app/backend/models.py with 'top','bottom','accessory' aliases. Option (a) is recommended (keeps backend taxonomy stable).
Smoke verified by code review (not exercised end-to-end this run): admin login → /admin and seller dashboard. These were not deep-tested per instructions.

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up its own addresses per test (autouse cleanup fixture). Buyer ends the FE test session with 1-2 addresses; tests are self-contained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_byo_addresses.py and can be re-run via `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration10_byo_addresses.py -v`. Buyer is 'buyer@aurafit.demo' / 'demo-buyer-2026'. Tabs in (tabs)/_layout.tsx do NOT have testIDs; navigate via Expo Router URLs /tryon, /profile, /addresses, /tryon/byo. AddressFields renders 'address-new-custom-label' only when label='other' is selected. Sheet preselected radio uses testID `checkout-address-<addr_id>`. POST /api/payments/checkout MUST include address_id in body — verified via network interception. The one open bug is the BYO garment_type FE↔BE taxonomy mismatch; everything else is green.
rca_of_issue: BYO garment_type bug RCA: /app/frontend/app/tryon/byo.tsx defines GARMENT_TYPES with keys ['top','dress','bottom','outerwear','shoes','accessory']. The state value (garmentType) is sent as-is to POST /api/tryon/garment in the `garment_type` field. The backend Pydantic model GarmentTryOnIn (models.py:495-506) uses the GarmentType Literal which does NOT include 'top', 'bottom', or 'accessory'. Reproduction: from Try-On tab → tap 'Try your own garment' → pick a garment → leave default 'Top' selected → tap 'Try It On'. Backend responds 422 literal_error. Mitigation (recommended): in byo.tsx generate(), translate UI key→backend key before sending: const FE_TO_BE = { top:'shirt', dress:'dress', bottom:'trousers', outerwear:'outerwear', shoes:'shoes', accessory:'other' }; pass FE_TO_BE[garmentType] as garment_type.
